pages.title: Censer Auras
pages.text: A Censer binds the virtues of two $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs)Herbs$(/l) into an aura. Place one herb at a time into an unlit Censer, then ignite a valid pair with a fire starter. Both herbs are consumed as the aura begins.

pages.title: Tending the Smoke
pages.text: The Censer burns for a time and carries its effect through the surrounding area. Before lighting, remove the last herb with an empty hand. Extinguish a burning Censer with a shovel.

pages.title: Tidewarden
pages.text: $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs#siren_kelp)Siren Kelp$(/l) + $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs#spirit_bloom)Spirit Bloom$(/l)$(br2)Creates a protective aura that grants Resistance and Slow Falling.

pages.title: Undead Veil
pages.text: $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs#ghost_fern)Ghost Fern$(/l) + $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs#spirit_bloom)Spirit Bloom$(/l)$(br2)Pacifies undead creatures within the area.

pages.title: Ethereal Grazing
pages.text: $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs#ghost_fern)Ghost Fern$(/l) + $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs#siren_kelp)Siren Kelp$(/l)$(br2)Encourages nearby animals of the same species to breed.

pages.title: Miner's Respite
pages.text: $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs#dreamshroom)Dreamshroom$(/l) + $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs#spirit_bloom)Spirit Bloom$(/l)$(br2)Grants Night Vision and Haste, and may restore damaged anvils.

pages.title: Tide's Memory
pages.text: $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs#dreamshroom)Dreamshroom$(/l) + $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs#siren_kelp)Siren Kelp$(/l)$(br2)Releases aquatic loot in large bodies of water and may summon a Guardian.

pages.title: Phantom Drift
pages.text: $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs#dreamshroom)Dreamshroom$(/l) + $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs#ghost_fern)Ghost Fern$(/l)$(br2)Moves nearby items into surrounding containers.

pages.title: Blighted Bloom
pages.text: $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs#witchweed)Witchweed$(/l) + $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs#dreamshroom)Dreamshroom$(/l)$(br2)Spreads mycelium, grows mushrooms, and may transform cows into mooshrooms.

pages.title: Tidal Pull
pages.text: $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs#witchweed)Witchweed$(/l) + $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs#siren_kelp)Siren Kelp$(/l)$(br2)Pulls nearby mobs and items toward the censer.

pages.title: Withering Calm
pages.text: $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs#witchweed)Witchweed$(/l) + $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs#ghost_fern)Ghost Fern$(/l)$(br2)Applies Wither while suppressing aggression from affected mobs.

pages.title: Hollow Aura
pages.text: $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs#witchweed)Witchweed$(/l) + $(l:hexalia:resources/herbs#spirit_bloom)Spirit Bloom$(/l)$(br2)Periodically removes beneficial effects from those within its range.

pages.title: On Pairing
pages.text: Each herb contributes its own nature to the resulting aura. Understanding how they combine allows for precise control over the effects created by the censer.
